A '''starfighter''' model used by the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]] featured a blocky underside with a square front and triangular rear. The [[Deflector shield/Legends|unshielded]] craft was capable of deploying floating [[Proximity mine/Legends|proximity mines]] from a rear compartment.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

After the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invaded]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Timeline">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]'' is set during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], which is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> its forces began rounding up [[Naboo (people)/Legends|civilians]] and placing them in newly established [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] camps. The Droid Army stationed two of its [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Minelayer (starship type)|minelayers]] to drop [[Mine/Legends|mines]] at a series of camps along the banks of the [[Andrevea River]]. The two [[Starship/Legends|ships]] were destroyed and the camps were [[Liberation of enslavement camps|liberated]] by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]], a Naboo [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who had sneaked into the camps in a stolen [[Ostracoda-class gunboat|Federation gunboat]].<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

==Behind the scenes==
The minelayer appeared in the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]'', developed by [[Factor 5]] and published by [[LucasArts]]. The player encounters them in the eighth level of the game, "Andrevea River."<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />
